import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter data for visualization
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot of the top 10 dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, y='Rasse1Text', hue='SexLang', order=top_breeds, palette='Set2')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich by Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
